notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p5), Total Governmental Funds column. Other Financing Sources: Issuance of Debt 1,965,000 = debt_proceeds; Premium on Bonds, Information Technology Subscriptions and Insurance Proceeds = other_financing (printed-section rule). 'Taxes' 18,766,477 kept unlabeled (category taxes): the Statement of Activities split (accrual, p3) does not tie to the fund statement and no fund schedule prints a breakdown. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement (p7), Combined Utilities column (internal service fund column excluded); capital contributions and loss on disposal in business_type.other_financing; business-type totals summed (no single printed total). ending_cash = pooled cash/investments plus cash at county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4); beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p2), lines by Governmental / Business-Type column, totals from Totals 2023 column; ties. Detail: budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedules for General (p10), City Highway Allocation and American Rescue Plan (p11), eight nonmajor special revenue funds (p13-15), Capital Construction and Special Assessments (p16) and Debt Service (p17), function lines only (not itemized); lines whose actual is '-' omitted. Community Development Agency from the nonmajor combining statement (p12, it has no budget schedule); other p12 columns not recorded to avoid double counting with their budget schedules. Utilities by division from the combining departmental schedule (p18; no utility budget schedule in the trim). Trim coverage: report pp17, 31-33, 35, 37-40, 75-76, 80-85, 88-89, 114-116 are kept; not in the trim are the governmental-fund reconciliations (report pp34, 36), the nonmajor combining balance sheet (p79) and report pp86-87 (likely the combining utilities statement of net position); none is needed for the cash-flow lines and every kept detail schedule is complete. Pages 1 (MD&A), 9 (cash flow continuation), 19 (combining cash flows) and 20-22 (statistical tables) have no detail lines. Read pages 1-22 of 22
